why.zh: 不变式：每一步开始时，nums[0..w) 恰好是已扫描部分 nums[0..r) 里该保留的元素，顺序不变。nums[r] 要保留就写到 w 再 w++，不变式依然成立；r 扫到末尾时 nums[0..w) 就是答案。
why.en: Invariant: at the start of each step, nums[0..w) holds exactly the kept elements of the scanned part nums[0..r), in their original order. Keeping nums[r] writes it at w and advances w, so the invariant holds again; when r reaches the end, nums[0..w) is the answer.

why.zh: 写入不会覆盖还没读的数据：始终有 w ≤ r，写入的格子一定已经读过。
why.en: A write never destroys unread data: w ≤ r at all times, so every write lands on a cell that has already been read.

why.zh: 从后往前合并两个有序数组：写指针 k = i + j + 1，只要 nums2 还没写完（j ≥ 0）就有 k > i，nums1 里没读的部分不会被覆盖。
why.en: Merging from the back: the write index is k = i + j + 1, so while nums2 still has elements (j ≥ 0), k > i and the unread part of nums1 is never overwritten.

say.zh: 这类题我用读写双指针。读指针 r 从左到右扫一遍，写指针 w 左边永远是已经确定的结果。遇到要保留的元素就写到 w 再右移 w，因为 w 不会超过 r，所以不会覆盖还没读的数据。整体一遍扫描，时间 O(n)，额外空间 O(1)。
say.en: I use a read pointer and a write pointer. The read pointer scans left to right once, and everything left of the write pointer is final. When an element should be kept, I copy it to the write position and advance it; since the write pointer never passes the read pointer, nothing unread is overwritten. That is one pass, O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

why.zh: 一遍扫描不会漏：任何一对答案 i < j，扫到 j 时 i 已经存进哈希表，所以一定在 j 处被查到；先查后存保证 j 不会和自己配对。
why.en: One pass misses nothing: for any answer pair i < j, index i is already in the map when the scan reaches j, so the pair is found at j. Looking up before storing means j is never paired with itself.

why.zh: 分组正确的条件是「键相同 ⇔ 属于同一类」。排序后的字符串、字母计数元组都满足这一点，所以每个桶里恰好是一类元素。
why.en: Grouping is correct when equal keys mean the same class and different classes get different keys. A sorted string or a letter-count tuple has that property, so each bucket holds exactly one class.

why.zh: 哈希表查找期望 O(1)，所以整体 O(n)；冲突很多时会退化，面试时可以提一句。
why.en: Expected O(1) lookups make the whole scan O(n); heavy collisions can degrade it, which is worth one sentence in an interview.

say.zh: 我用哈希表把找配对从 O(n²) 降到 O(n)。从左往右扫，每到一个元素先查它需要的另一半是否已经出现过，再把它自己存进去。任意一对答案在扫到右边那个元素时，左边那个已经在表里，所以不会漏；先查后存也保证不会和自己配对。时间 O(n)，空间 O(n)。
say.en: I use a hash map to turn the pair search from O(n²) into O(n). Scanning left to right, I first look up the complement of the current element, then store the element itself. For any valid pair, the left element is already in the map when I reach the right one, so nothing is missed, and looking up before storing prevents pairing an element with itself. That is O(n) time and O(n) space.

why.zh: 失配时只回退 j、不回退文本指针是安全的：还可能匹配成功的更早起点，对应的已匹配部分一定是当前已匹配串的一个「真前缀 = 后缀」，而 pi 给的正是最长的那个，按 pi 回退不会跳过任何可能的起点。
why.en: On a mismatch it is safe to move only j and never the text pointer: any earlier start that could still match corresponds to a proper prefix of the matched part that is also its suffix, and pi gives the longest such border, so falling back along pi skips no possible start.

why.zh: 线性复杂度来自势能论证：j 每步最多 +1，每次回退至少 −1，而且 j ≥ 0，所以回退总次数不超过前进总次数，整体 O(n + m)。
why.en: Linear time comes from a potential argument: j grows by at most 1 per step, every fallback shrinks it by at least 1, and j never goes below 0, so total fallbacks are bounded by total advances, O(n + m) overall.

say.zh: KMP 的核心是前缀函数 pi，pi[i] 表示模式串前 i+1 个字符里，既是真前缀又是后缀的最长长度。匹配时文本指针从不后退，失配就把模式指针跳到 pi[j−1]，因为能继续匹配的起点只可能对应这些前后缀相等的长度。模式指针每步最多加一、回退总量不超过前进总量，所以整体是 O(n + m)。建表本身就是模式串和自己匹配。
say.en: KMP rests on the prefix function: pi[i] is the length of the longest proper prefix of the first i + 1 pattern characters that is also a suffix. During matching the text pointer never moves back; on a mismatch the pattern pointer jumps to pi[j − 1], because any start that can still match corresponds to one of those borders. The pattern pointer rises by at most one per step and can only fall as much as it rose, so the whole thing is O(n + m). Building the table is the pattern matching against itself.

why.zh: 收缩左端不会漏解：如果 [l, r] 已经不合法，那么左端还是 l、右端 ≥ r 的窗口也都不合法，所以 l 可以永久右移。
why.en: Shrinking from the left never loses an answer: if [l, r] is invalid, every window that still starts at l and ends at r or later is invalid too, so l can move right for good.

why.zh: 前提是合法性对窗口包含关系单调：一个窗口合法，它的每个子窗口也合法。含负数的子数组和不满足这一点，所以要改用前缀和。
why.en: This needs validity to be monotone under containment: if a window is valid, every sub-window is valid too. Subarray sums with negative numbers break this, which is why they need prefix sums instead.

why.zh: 复杂度：l 和 r 都只增不减，各自最多走 n 步，所以内层 while 的总次数是 O(n)，不是 O(n²)。
why.en: Each of l and r only moves forward, at most n steps apiece, so the inner while runs O(n) times in total, not O(n²).

say.zh: 我用可变滑动窗口：右端每一步都扩张，窗口一旦不合法就移动左端直到恢复合法，在合适的位置更新答案。正确性靠单调性：一个窗口不合法时，同一个左端配更远的右端也不会合法，所以左端可以放心右移、不会漏解。两个指针都只往前走，总共 O(n)。如果数组里有负数导致这种单调性不成立，我会换成前缀和加哈希表。
say.en: I use a variable-size sliding window: the right end grows every step, and while the window is invalid the left end moves forward until it is valid again. It is correct because validity is monotone: if a window is invalid, keeping the same left end with a farther right end cannot fix it, so moving the left end never skips an answer. Both pointers only move forward, so the total work is O(n). If negative numbers break that monotonicity, I switch to prefix sums with a hash map.

why.zh: sum(l..r) = pre[r+1] − pre[l]，所以以 r 结尾、和为 k 的子数组个数，等于之前出现过多少个等于 pre[r+1] − k 的前缀和。哈希表按前缀和计数，一遍扫描把所有子数组按右端点分组数完，每个恰好算一次。
why.en: Because sum(l..r) = pre[r+1] − pre[l], the number of subarrays ending at r with sum k equals how many earlier prefix sums equal pre[r+1] − k. Counting prefix sums in a hash map tallies every subarray exactly once, grouped by its right end, in one pass.

why.zh: {0: 1} 代表空前缀 pre[0]，没有它就会漏掉从下标 0 开始的子数组。
why.en: The seed {0: 1} stands for the empty prefix pre[0]; without it, subarrays starting at index 0 are missed.

why.zh: 差分数组是前缀和的逆运算：diff[l] += v、diff[r+1] −= v 之后求一次前缀和，只有 [l, r] 内的位置加上了 v。
why.en: A difference array is the inverse of prefix sums: after diff[l] += v and diff[r+1] −= v, one prefix pass adds v to exactly the positions l..r.

say.zh: 子数组和可以写成两个前缀和的差，pre[r+1] − pre[l]。所以我从左往右扫，维护当前前缀和，同时用哈希表记录每个前缀和出现过几次；以当前位置结尾、和为 k 的子数组数量，就是之前前缀和等于当前值减 k 的次数。哈希表要先放入 {0: 1} 表示空前缀。这样每个子数组按右端点恰好统计一次，时间 O(n)，而且对负数也成立。
say.en: A subarray sum is the difference of two prefix sums, pre[r + 1] minus pre[l]. So I scan once, keep the running prefix sum, and count in a hash map how often each prefix sum has appeared; the subarrays ending here with sum k are exactly the earlier prefixes equal to the current sum minus k. I seed the map with zero seen once for the empty prefix. Every subarray is counted once at its right end, in O(n) time, and unlike a sliding window it works with negative numbers.

why.zh: 不变式：lo 左边全是 false，hi 及其右边全是 true（或越界）。ok(mid) 为真就 hi = mid，否则 lo = mid + 1，两种更新都保持不变式。前提是 ok 单调：前一段全 false、后一段全 true。
why.en: Invariant: everything left of lo is false, and everything from hi on is true (or out of range). Setting hi = mid when ok(mid) holds and lo = mid + 1 otherwise both keep it. This needs ok to be monotone: all false, then all true.

why.zh: 终止性：lo < hi 时 mid = lo + (hi − lo) / 2 满足 lo ≤ mid < hi，每轮区间严格缩小；结束时 lo == hi，按不变式它就是第一个 true。
why.en: Termination: while lo < hi, mid = lo + (hi − lo) / 2 satisfies lo ≤ mid < hi, so the range strictly shrinks each round; when lo == hi, the invariant says it is the first true.

why.zh: 二分答案成立也是因为单调：速度越快越能按时完成，上限越大越容易满足，可行性检查对答案单调，就能对答案本身二分。
why.en: Binary searching the answer works for the same reason: a faster speed or a looser limit can only make the goal easier, so the feasibility check is monotone in the answer.

say.zh: 我先把问题改写成一个单调的判定 ok(x)：前面一段全是 false，后面全是 true，然后找第一个 true。在半开区间 [lo, hi) 上，ok(mid) 为真就 hi = mid，否则 lo = mid + 1，始终保持 lo 左边都是 false、hi 往右都是 true。每轮区间严格变小，结束时 lo 等于 hi，就是答案。判定是 O(n) 的话，总复杂度是 O(n log 范围)。
say.en: I first rewrite the problem as a monotone check ok(x) that is false and then true, and search for the first true. On the half-open range from lo to hi, I set hi to mid when ok(mid) holds and lo to mid plus one otherwise, which keeps everything left of lo false and everything from hi on true. The range shrinks every round, and when lo meets hi that index is the answer. With an O(n) check the total cost is O(n log of the range).

why.zh: x 到来时下标 i 还在栈里，说明 i 和当前位置之间没有比 nums[i] 更大的数（否则 i 早被弹出），所以弹出 i 的 x 就是它右边第一个更大的数。
why.en: If index i is still on the stack when x arrives, nothing between i and here was greater than nums[i] (it would have popped i), so the x that pops i is its next greater element.

why.zh: 均摊 O(n)：每个下标恰好入栈一次、最多出栈一次，所有 while 循环加起来最多弹出 n 次。
why.en: Amortised O(n): each index is pushed exactly once and popped at most once, so all the while loops together pop at most n times.

why.zh: 大小为 k 的最小堆：堆顶是保留的 k 个里最小的，新元素只有比堆顶大才可能进前 k 大，替换堆顶不会丢掉真正的前 k 大。
why.en: A size-k min-heap: its top is the smallest of the k kept values, so a new value can belong to the top k only if it beats the top, and replacing the top never evicts a true top-k value.

say.zh: 找右边第一个更大的数，我用单调栈，栈里存下标，对应的值从底到顶递减。新元素到来时，把比它小的都弹出，并把它们的答案记为这个新元素。一个下标还留在栈里，说明中间没有更大的数，所以弹出时记下的一定是第一个更大的。每个下标只进出栈各一次，所以虽然有嵌套 while，总复杂度还是 O(n)。
say.en: For the next greater element I keep a monotonic stack of indexes whose values decrease from bottom to top. When a new value arrives, I pop every smaller one and record the new value as its answer. An index still on the stack means nothing in between was larger, so the value that pops it really is the first greater one. Each index is pushed and popped at most once, so despite the nested loop the total is O(n).

why.zh: 交换论证：设最优解里结束最早的区间是 o，贪心选的是全体里结束最早的 g，g.end ≤ o.end。把 o 换成 g，最优解里其余区间都在 o.end 之后开始，自然也在 g.end 之后，仍然互不重叠，数量不变。
why.en: Exchange argument: let o be the earliest-ending interval in an optimal answer and g the earliest-ending interval overall, the one greedy picks, so g.end ≤ o.end. Swapping o for g keeps the rest compatible, since they all start after o.end and hence after g.end, and the count is unchanged.

why.zh: 归纳：换完之后，剩下的是「在 g.end 之后开始的区间里选最多」，和原问题同构，对剩余部分重复同样的论证即可。
why.en: Induction: after the swap, what is left is the same problem on the intervals that start after g.end, so the same argument applies to the rest.

why.zh: 按开始时间或按长度排序都有反例：[1,10]、[2,3]、[4,5] 按开始时间只能选 1 个；[1,5]、[4,7]、[6,10] 先选最短的 [4,7] 也只能选 1 个，而最优都是 2 个。
why.en: Sorting by start or by length both fail: with [1,10], [2,3], [4,5], start order keeps only one; with [1,5], [4,7], [6,10], taking the shortest [4,7] first also keeps only one, while two is possible in both.

say.zh: 选最多的不重叠区间，我按结束时间排序，能放就放。理由是交换论证：最优解里结束最早的那个区间，总可以换成我选的这个结束更早的区间，后面的区间不受影响，数量不变。换完后剩下的是同样的问题，归纳下去就证明了贪心最优。排序 O(n log n)，扫描 O(n)；按开始时间或长度排序都有反例。
say.en: To keep the most non-overlapping intervals, I sort by end time and take each interval that fits. The exchange argument says the earliest-ending interval of any optimal answer can be swapped for mine, which ends no later, without breaking the rest or changing the count. What remains is the same problem, so induction shows greedy is optimal. Sorting costs O(n log n) and the scan O(n), and sorting by start or by length both have counterexamples.

why.zh: 反转的不变式：prev 是已反转部分的头，cur 是未处理部分的头，两段互不相连。每步先存 cur.next，再让 cur 指向 prev，然后一起前进，不变式保持；cur 为空时 prev 就是新头。
why.en: Reversal invariant: prev heads the reversed part and cur heads the untouched part, and the two are disconnected. Each step saves cur.next, points cur at prev and moves both forward, keeping the invariant; when cur is null, prev is the new head.

why.zh: 快慢指针判环：两者都进环后，快指针每步多走一格，距离每步减一（按环长取模），所以一圈之内必然相遇；无环时快指针先走到空。
why.en: Fast and slow pointers on a cycle: once both are inside it, the fast pointer gains one node per step, so the gap shrinks by one each step (mod the cycle length) and they meet within one lap; with no cycle the fast pointer reaches null first.

why.zh: 哑节点让「删头节点」和「删中间节点」变成同一种操作：每个真实节点都有前驱，不需要特判。
why.en: A dummy node makes deleting the head the same operation as deleting any other node: every real node has a predecessor, so there is no special case.

say.zh: 链表题我先想清楚指针改动的顺序。反转时维护 prev 和 cur：先存下 cur.next，再把 cur 指回 prev，然后两个指针一起前进，cur 为空时 prev 就是新头。可能删头或换头时加一个哑节点，所有真实节点都有前驱，省掉特判。判环或找中点用快慢指针，进环后快指针每步追近一格，一定会相遇。都是 O(n) 时间、O(1) 空间。
say.en: For linked lists I first fix the order of pointer changes. To reverse, I keep prev and cur: save cur.next, point cur back at prev, then advance both, and when cur is null prev is the new head. When the head might change I add a dummy node so every real node has a predecessor. For cycles and midpoints I use fast and slow pointers, and inside a cycle the fast one closes the gap by one node per step, so they must meet.

why.zh: 每轮开始时队列里恰好是同一层的全部节点：第 0 轮只有根；处理完这一层的 size 个节点后，新入队的正好是它们的全部孩子，也就是下一层。归纳可知层与层不会混在一起。
why.en: At the start of each round the queue holds exactly one whole level: round 0 has just the root, and after processing that level's size nodes, what was enqueued is exactly their children, the next level. By induction, levels never mix.

why.zh: 递归 DFS 的正确性是结构归纳：假设左右子树返回的值都正确，只要当前节点能用它们正确合并出自己的值，整棵树就正确；空树是基础情况。
why.en: Recursive DFS is correct by structural induction: assume both subtrees return correct values; if the node merges them correctly, the whole tree is correct, with the empty tree as the base case.

say.zh: 层序遍历我用队列，每一轮开始先记下队列长度，正好处理这么多个节点，这样一层和下一层不会混在一起：处理完这一层，队列里剩下的恰好是下一层。如果是 DFS，我先定义子树要返回什么，比如高度或是否平衡，再用左右子树的结果合并出当前节点，正确性靠结构归纳。每个节点访问一次，O(n)。
say.en: For level order I use a queue and record its length at the start of each round, then process exactly that many nodes, so one level never mixes with the next. After a round, the queue holds exactly the following level. For DFS, I first define what a subtree returns, such as its height or whether it is balanced, then combine the left and right results at the node, which is correct by structural induction. Every node is visited once, so it is O(n).

why.zh: 每条路径都有唯一的最高点（离根最近的节点）。以每个节点为最高点算一次 left + node + right，就枚举了所有路径，全局最大值正确。
why.en: Every path has a unique highest node, the one closest to the root. Computing left + node + right with each node as that highest point covers every path, so the global maximum is right.

why.zh: 返回给父节点的只能是单侧链 node + max(left, right, 0)：路径经过父节点后，下面就不能再分叉，否则不是一条简单路径。
why.en: What goes up to the parent can only be a one-sided chain, node + max(left, right, 0): a path that continues through the parent cannot also fork below, or it would not be a simple path.

why.zh: 负的贡献取 0，相当于不接这一侧，因为接上负数只会让路径更差。
why.en: Clamping a negative gain to 0 means leaving that side out, since adding a negative chain only makes the path worse.

say.zh: 树上最大路径和，我让递归函数返回从当前节点往下走的最大单侧链，负数当 0，不接。每条路径都有唯一的最高点，所以在每个节点把左链、自己、右链拼起来更新一次全局答案，就覆盖了所有路径。拐弯的路径只更新答案、不返回给父节点，因为经过父节点之后下面就不能再分叉。每个节点算一次，O(n)。
say.en: For the maximum path sum, my recursion returns the best one-sided chain going down from the node, treating a negative chain as zero. Every path has a single highest node, so joining the left chain, the node and the right chain at every node and updating a global best covers all paths. The bent path only updates the answer and is never returned, because a path going up through the parent cannot fork below it. Each node is handled once, so it is O(n).

why.zh: 先序的第一个值一定是根。值互不相同时，它在中序里的位置唯一，左边恰好是左子树的全部节点、右边是右子树，于是左右子树的大小也确定了，递归下去重建出的树唯一。
why.en: The first preorder value is always the root. With distinct values its inorder position is unique, everything left of it is exactly the left subtree and everything right of it the right subtree, so the subtree sizes are fixed and the recursion rebuilds a unique tree.

why.zh: 先序是「根、整个左子树、整个右子树」，所以先递归左子树、再递归右子树时，用一个全局指针顺序读先序，读到的总是下一个子树的根。
why.en: Preorder is root, then the whole left subtree, then the whole right subtree, so if you recurse left before right, a single pointer reading preorder in order always lands on the next subtree's root.

why.zh: 值有重复时，根在中序里的位置不唯一，树也可能不唯一，这就是题目保证值互不相同的原因。
why.en: With duplicate values the root's inorder position is ambiguous and the tree may not be unique, which is why these problems promise distinct values.

say.zh: 先序的第一个值是根，我在中序里找到它，左边是左子树、右边是右子树，然后递归构造。为了 O(1) 定位，先建一个值到中序下标的哈希表。因为先序是根、左子树、右子树的顺序，只要先建左再建右，用一个指针顺序读先序就总能拿到下一个根。整体 O(n)，前提是值互不相同。
say.en: The first preorder value is the root; I find it in the inorder array, where everything to its left is the left subtree and everything to its right is the right subtree, and recurse. A map from value to inorder index makes each lookup O(1). Because preorder lists root, left subtree, right subtree, building left before right lets one pointer read preorder in order and always get the next root. The build is O(n), given distinct values.

why.zh: 中序有序：对任意节点，中序先输出整棵左子树（都比它小），再输出它，再输出右子树（都比它大）；对每棵子树归纳，整个序列严格递增。
why.en: Why inorder is sorted: at every node, inorder emits the whole left subtree (all smaller), then the node, then the right subtree (all larger); by induction on subtrees, the sequence is strictly increasing.

why.zh: 只和父节点比较不够：BST 要求整棵子树都落在祖先允许的范围内，所以要把 (lo, hi) 一路传下去。比如 [5, 1, 6, null, null, 3, 7]，3 比父节点 6 小，但它在 5 的右子树里，不合法。
why.en: Comparing with the parent alone is not enough: a whole subtree must fit the range its ancestors allow, so pass (lo, hi) bounds down. In [5, 1, 6, null, null, 3, 7], 3 is smaller than its parent 6 but sits in 5's right subtree, so the tree is invalid.

why.zh: 查找每步只走一边，因为另一边整棵子树都不可能含目标，所以只走一条路径，O(h)。
why.en: Search goes to one side at each step because the other subtree cannot contain the target, so it follows a single path in O(h).

say.zh: 二叉搜索树最有用的性质是中序遍历有序，因为每个节点都是先输出更小的左子树、再输出自己、再输出更大的右子树。所以第 k 小、验证 BST、找前驱后继，我都转成中序遍历，用栈迭代可以在第 k 个时提前停下。验证时不能只和父节点比，要把上下界一路传下去。查找和插入只走一条路径，O(h)。
say.en: The most useful BST fact is that an inorder walk is sorted, since every node emits its smaller left subtree, then itself, then its larger right subtree. So I turn k-th smallest, validation and predecessor or successor into inorder walks, and an iterative walk with a stack can stop as soon as it reaches the k-th node. To validate, I pass lower and upper bounds down instead of comparing with the parent only. Search and insert follow a single path, which is O(h).

why.zh: BFS 按距离分层出队：距离为 d 的格子全部出队后，距离 d + 1 的才开始出队，所以一个格子第一次被发现时所在的层数就是最短步数。
why.en: BFS dequeues by distance: all cells at distance d leave the queue before any at d + 1, so the layer in which a cell is first discovered is its shortest distance.

why.zh: 多源 BFS 等价于从一个虚拟超级源点出发，它到每个真实源点的边权为 0；所以把所有源点一起放进第 0 层，算出的就是到最近源点的距离。
why.en: Multi-source BFS is the same as starting from one virtual super source with zero-cost edges to every real source, so putting all sources in layer 0 gives each cell its distance to the nearest source.

why.zh: 入队时就标记已访问：一个格子可能被同一层的多个邻居发现，晚标记会让它重复入队，答案不变，但最坏会多花很多时间和内存。
why.en: Mark cells when they are enqueued: a cell can be discovered by several neighbours in the same layer, and marking later enqueues it repeatedly, which keeps the answer but can blow up time and memory.

say.zh: 网格最短步数我用 BFS，因为 BFS 按层扩展，一个格子第一次被发现时的层数就是最短距离。多个起点就一开始把所有起点一起入队，相当于从一个虚拟超级源点出发，算出的是到最近起点的距离。格子入队时就标记已访问，避免重复入队。每个格子最多入队一次，时间是行数乘列数。
say.en: For the fewest steps on a grid I use BFS, since it expands layer by layer and the layer where a cell is first found is its shortest distance. With several starting points I enqueue all of them at the start, which is like one virtual super source, and I get the distance to the nearest source. I mark a cell visited when I enqueue it so it never enters the queue twice. Each cell is enqueued at most once, so the cost is rows times columns.

why.zh: 每个集合是一棵树，树根是代表元；find 返回根，所以两点同根 ⇔ 属于同一连通分量。union 只是把一个根挂到另一个根下，不会拆开已有的连通关系。
why.en: Each set is a tree whose root represents it; find returns the root, so two nodes share a root exactly when they are in the same component. union only hangs one root under another, so it never breaks an existing connection.

why.zh: 按大小合并保证树高 O(log n)：一个节点所在的树每变深一次，它所在集合的大小至少翻倍，最多翻 log n 次。再加上路径压缩，均摊接近常数（反阿克曼函数 α(n)）。
why.en: Union by size keeps trees O(log n) tall: every time a node's tree gets deeper, the size of its set at least doubles, which can happen only log n times. Adding path compression brings the amortised cost close to constant, α(n).

why.zh: union 返回 false 说明两端已经连通，再加这条边就会成环，这就是判冗余边的依据。
why.en: union returning false means the endpoints were already connected, so the edge would close a cycle, which is how redundant edges are detected.

say.zh: 动态连通性我用并查集。每个集合是一棵树，根是代表元，两点同根就说明连通。find 时做路径压缩，union 时把小树挂到大树下，按大小合并保证树高 O(log n)，两者一起均摊接近常数。如果 union 发现两点已经同根，说明这条边会成环，可以直接用来判冗余边。
say.en: For dynamic connectivity I use union-find. Each set is a tree whose root represents it, and two nodes are connected exactly when they share a root. find compresses paths and union hangs the smaller tree under the larger, which keeps trees logarithmic, and together they cost nearly constant time amortised. If union finds both ends already share a root, the edge would close a cycle, which detects redundant edges directly.

why.zh: 入度为 0 的点没有未完成的前驱，放在当前位置不会违反任何边的方向；删掉它的出边后，剩下的图仍然是同样的问题。
why.en: A node with in-degree 0 has no unfinished prerequisites, so placing it next violates no edge; removing its out-edges leaves the same problem on a smaller graph.

why.zh: 环上每个点的入度永远至少为 1（它在环上的前驱永远不会被取出），所以输出的点少于 n ⇔ 图中有环。
why.en: On a cycle, every node keeps in-degree at least 1 because its predecessor on the cycle is never output, so fewer than n output nodes means exactly that the graph has a cycle.

why.zh: 任何有向无环图都至少有一个入度为 0 的点（否则沿入边一直往回走，终会重复某个点、形成环），所以只要无环，队列就不会提前变空。
why.en: Every DAG has at least one node with in-degree 0 (otherwise walking backwards along incoming edges would eventually repeat a node and form a cycle), so without a cycle the queue never runs dry early.

say.zh: 拓扑排序我用 Kahn 算法：先统计入度，把入度为 0 的点入队；每取出一个点就放进结果，并把它指向的点入度减一，减到 0 就入队。入度为 0 意味着前驱都已完成，所以放在这里不会违反依赖。如果最后输出的点少于 n，剩下的点都在环上，课程表这类题就是靠这个判断。时间 O(V + E)。
say.en: For topological order I use Kahn's algorithm: count in-degrees and enqueue every node with none. Each node I dequeue goes into the result, and every node it points to loses one in-degree and is enqueued when it reaches zero. In-degree zero means all its prerequisites are done, so placing it violates nothing. If fewer than n nodes come out, the rest lie on a cycle, which answers course schedule problems, all in O(V + E).

why.zh: 出堆即确定：堆顶 u 的距离 d 是所有未确定点里最小的。别的路径要到 u，必须先经过某个未确定点 v（距离 ≥ d），再加上非负边权，不可能比 d 更短。
why.en: Popped means final: the top node u has the smallest tentative distance d among unsettled nodes. Any other route to u must leave the settled set through some unsettled v with distance ≥ d and then add non-negative edges, so it cannot be shorter than d.

why.zh: 负边会打破这个论证。反例：A→B 权 1，A→C 权 2，C→B 权 −2。B 以距离 1 先出堆，但真实最短是 A→C→B = 0。给出堆的点打「已完成」标记的写法会直接返回 1；懒删除写法会再次松弛 B，但复杂度保证没有了，所以负边要换 Bellman-Ford。
why.en: Negative edges break that argument. Counterexample: A→B weight 1, A→C weight 2, C→B weight −2. B pops first with distance 1, but the true shortest path A→C→B costs 0. A version that marks popped nodes done returns 1; the lazy-deletion version relaxes B again but loses its running-time guarantee, so negative edges call for Bellman-Ford.

why.zh: 懒删除不影响正确性：过期条目的 d 大于 dist[u]，而 u 更短的那个条目更早出堆、已经松弛过邻居，跳过过期条目不会丢信息。
why.en: Lazy deletion is safe: a stale entry has d > dist[u], and the shorter entry for u already popped earlier and relaxed its neighbours, so skipping the stale one loses nothing.

say.zh: 非负权最短路我用 Dijkstra：堆里按当前距离取最小的点，取出即确定，再去松弛它的邻居。之所以取出即确定，是因为别的路径要绕过来，得先经过一个距离不小于它的点，再加非负边，不可能更短。我不用 decrease-key，而是把新距离直接入堆，出堆时跳过比 dist 大的过期条目。复杂度 O((V+E) log V)；有负边就换 Bellman-Ford，0/1 边权用双端队列 BFS。
say.en: For shortest paths with non-negative weights I use Dijkstra: pop the node with the smallest tentative distance, treat it as final, and relax its neighbours. It is final because any other route would have to pass through a node at least as far away and then add non-negative edges. Instead of decrease-key I push the new distance and skip stale entries larger than dist when they pop. That is O((V + E) log V); with negative edges I switch to Bellman-Ford, and with 0/1 weights to a deque BFS.

why.zh: 切割性质：把点集任意分成两部分，横跨两部分的最轻边一定属于某棵最小生成树。若某棵树不含它，把它加进去会成环，环上必有另一条横跨边，换掉那条不会变重。
why.en: Cut property: for any split of the nodes into two sides, the lightest edge crossing the split belongs to some minimum spanning tree. If a tree lacks it, adding it closes a cycle with another crossing edge, and swapping that one out cannot make the tree heavier.

why.zh: Kruskal 接受的每条边，都是连接两个不同分量的边里最轻的，也就是「其中一个分量 vs 其余所有点」这个切割上的最轻边，所以每一步都安全。成环的边两端已在同一分量，永远用不上。
why.en: Each edge Kruskal accepts is the lightest edge joining two different components, which makes it the lightest edge across the cut between one of those components and everything else, so every step is safe. An edge inside one component would close a cycle and is never needed.

say.zh: 最小生成树我用 Kruskal：边按权重从小到大排序，用并查集判断两端是否已连通，不连通就选上，连通就跳过，因为它会成环。正确性来自切割性质：每次选的边都是某个切割上最轻的横跨边，一定出现在某棵最小生成树里。选满 n−1 条就是生成树，不够说明图不连通。复杂度主要是排序，O(E log E)。
say.en: For a minimum spanning tree I use Kruskal: sort the edges by weight, and take each edge whose endpoints union-find says are not yet connected, skipping the ones that would close a cycle. It is correct by the cut property: every accepted edge is the lightest edge across some cut, so it belongs to some minimum spanning tree. With n minus one edges chosen I have a spanning tree, and fewer means the graph is disconnected. Sorting dominates, so it is O(E log E).

why.zh: 搜索树的每个节点对应一个部分解。「选择 → 递归 → 撤销」保证从子节点返回时 path 恢复原样，兄弟分支看到的状态互不干扰。
why.en: Each node of the search tree is a partial solution; choose, recurse, undo guarantees path is restored when a child returns, so sibling branches never see each other's state.

why.zh: 组合从 start 往后选，等于强制下标递增，而每个组合只有一种递增排列，所以恰好生成一次，不重不漏。
why.en: Choosing combinations from start onwards forces indexes to increase, and each combination has exactly one increasing order, so each is generated exactly once.

why.zh: 去重条件 i > start && nums[i] == nums[i−1]：排序后相同的值相邻，同一层只让第一个展开，它的子树已经包含了后面那些相同值能得到的全部结果。
why.en: The dedupe test i > start && nums[i] == nums[i−1]: after sorting, equal values sit together, and only the first of them branches on a level, because its subtree already contains every result the later copies could produce.

say.zh: 枚举子集、组合、排列，我用回溯三步：选择、递归、撤销。path 是整个搜索共用的一个缓冲区，撤销保证兄弟分支互不干扰。组合从 start 往后选，强制下标递增，每个组合只出现一次；有重复元素就先排序，同一层跳过和前一个相同的值。复杂度和答案数量同阶，比如子集是 O(n · 2^n)。
say.en: For subsets, combinations and permutations I backtrack in three moves: choose, recurse, undo. path is one buffer shared by the whole search, and undoing keeps sibling branches independent. Combinations pick from start onward, so indexes increase and each combination appears once; with duplicates I sort and skip a value equal to the previous one on the same level. The cost matches the output size, for example O(n · 2^n) for subsets.

why.zh: 每种切分方式唯一对应一串递增的切点，搜索每层决定「下一段在哪里结束」，所以每种切分恰好生成一次。
why.en: Every way to split corresponds to exactly one increasing sequence of cut points, and each level of the search picks where the next piece ends, so every split is generated exactly once.

why.zh: 回文表 isPal[i][j] = (s[i] == s[j]) 且 isPal[i+1][j−1]，只依赖更短的区间，所以 i 从后往前填，用到时一定已经算好。
why.en: The palindrome table isPal[i][j] = (s[i] == s[j]) and isPal[i+1][j−1] depends only on shorter ranges, so filling i from the back guarantees every entry is ready when used.

why.zh: 剪枝只剪「当前这一段不合法」的分支：不合法的段不可能出现在任何合法切分里，剪掉不会漏解。
why.en: Pruning cuts only branches whose current piece is invalid; an invalid piece can appear in no valid split, so nothing is lost.

say.zh: 字符串切分我用回溯，每一层决定下一段在哪里结束，start 走到末尾就得到一种完整切分；每种切分对应唯一一串切点，所以不重不漏。判断某一段是否回文，我先用 O(n²) 的区间 DP 预处理，搜索里每次检查就是 O(1)。复原 IP、单词拆分也是同一个框架，只是这一段是否合法的判断不同。答案数最坏是指数级，复杂度 O(n · 2^n)。
say.en: To partition a string I backtrack, and each level chooses where the next piece ends; when start reaches the end I have one complete split, and since each split is a unique sequence of cuts, none repeats or goes missing. I precompute an O(n²) palindrome table so each check inside the search is O(1). Restoring IP addresses and word break use the same frame with a different validity test. The number of answers can be exponential, so the worst case is O(n · 2^n).

why.zh: 每行恰好放一个皇后不会漏解：任何合法摆法里 n 个皇后两两不同行，所以必然每行一个，按行搜索只是固定了枚举顺序。
why.en: Placing exactly one queen per row loses nothing: in any valid board the n queens are in distinct rows, so there is one per row, and searching row by row only fixes the order of enumeration.

why.zh: 同一条主对角线上 r − c 相同，同一条副对角线上 r + c 相同，所以三个布尔数组就能 O(1) 判断冲突。
why.en: Cells on one diagonal share r − c and cells on one anti-diagonal share r + c, so three boolean arrays check a conflict in O(1).

why.zh: 剪枝是安全的：被剪掉的部分摆法已经有冲突，继续往下放只会保留这个冲突，不可能变成合法解。
why.en: Pruning is safe because a pruned partial board already has a conflict, and placing more queens keeps that conflict, so it can never become valid.

say.zh: N 皇后我按行回溯，每行放一个，只在列上分支。用三个数组分别标记列、主对角线 r − c 和副对角线 r + c，放之前 O(1) 检查冲突，有冲突就不递归，越早剪越好。之所以安全，是因为已经冲突的部分摆法再怎么往下放都不会变合法。数独、组合总和也一样，先排序，后面不可能满足就直接 break。
say.en: For N-Queens I backtrack row by row, one queen per row, branching only on the column. Three arrays mark used columns, diagonals r − c and anti-diagonals r + c, so I check a conflict in O(1) before recursing and prune as early as possible. That is safe because a partial board with a conflict can never become valid by adding queens. Sudoku and combination sum work the same way: sort first and break as soon as the rest cannot fit.

why.zh: 最优子结构：前 i 个元素的最优解去掉最后一个决策，剩下的必须是对应子问题的最优解；否则换成更优的子解，整体会更好，矛盾。
why.en: Optimal substructure: remove the last decision from the best answer for the first i elements, and what remains must be optimal for its subproblem; otherwise swapping in a better sub-answer would beat the best answer, a contradiction.

why.zh: 按最后一个决策分类（偷不偷第 i 家、最后一步跨 1 级还是 2 级），把所有方案分成互不相交、又覆盖全部的几类，所以取 max 或求和不漏也不重。
why.en: Splitting by the last decision (rob house i or not, last step of 1 or 2) divides all plans into disjoint classes that cover everything, so taking a max or a sum neither misses nor double counts.

why.zh: 滚动变量只在 dp[i] 只依赖 dp[i−1] 和 dp[i−2] 时成立，而且要先用旧值算出新值，再整体前移。
why.en: Rolling variables work only when dp[i] depends on dp[i−1] and dp[i−2] alone, and the new value must be computed from the old ones before shifting them forward.

say.zh: 动态规划我先用一句话定义状态，比如 dp[i] 表示用前 i 个元素能得到的最优值。然后按最后一个决策分类写转移：第 i 个选或不选，这几类互不重叠又覆盖所有方案，所以取最大值不会漏。正确性靠最优子结构：最优解去掉最后一步，剩下的也一定是子问题的最优解。如果只依赖前两项，就用两个变量滚动，空间降到 O(1)。
say.en: For DP I first define the state in one sentence, such as dp[i] being the best value using the first i elements. Then I write the transition by the last decision, take element i or not, and since those cases are disjoint and cover every plan, the max misses nothing. It is correct by optimal substructure: remove the last step from a best answer and what remains is a best answer to the smaller problem. When dp[i] needs only the previous two values, I roll two variables and use O(1) space.

why.zh: 到达 (r, c) 的最后一步只能来自上方或左方，两类互不相交，所以最小路径和 = 格子值 + min(上, 左)，路径数 = 上 + 左。
why.en: The last step into (r, c) comes from above or from the left, and the two cases are disjoint, so the minimum path sum is the cell plus min(above, left) and the path count is above plus left.

why.zh: 一维压缩为什么对：按行从左到右更新，更新 dp[c] 之前它还是上一行的值（上方），dp[c−1] 已经是本行的新值（左方），正好是转移需要的两个值。
why.en: Why one row suffices: filling left to right, dp[c] still holds the previous row's value (above) before its update, while dp[c−1] already holds this row's (left), exactly the two values the transition needs.

say.zh: 网格 DP 里，到达一个格子的最后一步只能从上面或左边来，所以 dp[r][c] 等于格子值加上上方和左方里更小的那个；计数题就把两者相加，障碍格设为 0。第一行和第一列只有一个来源，单独初始化或者用无穷大做哨兵。空间可以压到一行：从左往右更新时，dp[c] 更新前是上方的值，dp[c−1] 已经是左方的新值。时间 O(行 × 列)，空间 O(列)。
say.en: In grid DP the last step into a cell comes from above or from the left, so dp[r][c] is the cell value plus the smaller of those two; for counting I add them instead and set obstacles to zero. The first row and column have only one source, so I initialise them separately or use an infinity sentinel. One row of memory is enough: filling left to right, dp[c] still holds the value above, and dp[c − 1] already holds the new value to the left. That is O(rows × cols) time and O(cols) space.

why.zh: 0/1 背包容量倒序：更新 dp[s] 时 dp[s−x] 本轮还没被改过，仍是不含物品 x 的值，所以 x 最多用一次；正序时 dp[s−x] 可能已经用过 x，物品会被重复使用，这正是完全背包需要的。
why.en: 0/1 knapsack loops capacity downwards: when dp[s] updates, dp[s−x] has not been touched this round and still excludes item x, so x is used at most once. Looping upwards, dp[s−x] may already include x, which reuses the item, exactly what the unbounded version wants.

why.zh: 物品在外层时，每种组合只按物品顺序被数一次，得到组合数；容量在外层时，每一步都可以让任意物品当最后一个，不同顺序分别计数，得到排列数。例如硬币 {1, 2, 3} 凑 5：组合 5 种，排列 13 种。
why.en: With items in the outer loop, each combination is counted once in item order, which counts combinations; with capacity outside, any item can be the last one at every step, so different orders count separately, which counts permutations. Coins {1, 2, 3} make 5 in 5 combinations but 13 orders.

why.zh: 目标和的归约：设加正号的数之和为 P，则 P − (sum − P) = target，P = (sum + target) / 2，所以还要求 sum + target 是非负偶数。
why.en: Target sum reduces to a knapsack: if the plus-signed numbers sum to P, then P − (sum − P) = target, so P = (sum + target) / 2, which also requires sum + target to be even and non-negative.

say.zh: 背包问题我用一维数组 dp[s]。0/1 背包容量倒着循环，这样 dp[s − x] 还是没放这个物品时的值，每个物品最多用一次；完全背包正着循环，允许重复使用。计数时，物品在外层得到组合数，容量在外层得到排列数。很多题能归约成背包，比如分割等和子集就是问 sum/2 能不能凑出来。复杂度 O(n × 容量)。
say.en: For knapsacks I use a one-dimensional dp over capacity. The 0/1 version loops capacity downwards so dp[s − x] still excludes the current item, using each item at most once, and the unbounded version loops upwards to allow reuse. When counting, items in the outer loop count combinations and capacity in the outer loop counts permutations. Many problems reduce to this, for example equal-sum partition asks whether half the total is reachable, all in O(n × capacity).

why.zh: tails 严格递增：长度为 k+1 的递增子序列去掉最后一个元素，得到一个结尾更小的长度为 k 的子序列，所以 tails[k] < tails[k+1]，可以二分。
why.en: tails is strictly increasing: drop the last element of an increasing subsequence of length k+1 and you get one of length k with a smaller end, so tails[k] < tails[k+1], which allows binary search.

why.zh: 用 x 替换第一个 ≥ x 的位置，只会让某个长度的最小结尾变小，不改变已达到的最大长度；结尾越小越容易被后面的数接上，所以这个贪心不会让答案变差。
why.en: Replacing the first entry ≥ x with x only lowers the smallest end for one length and never changes the longest length reached; a smaller end is easier to extend later, so this greedy never makes the answer worse.

why.zh: tails 本身通常不是一个真实的子序列，只有它的长度是答案；要输出序列，需要另外记录前驱。
why.en: tails is usually not an actual subsequence; only its length is the answer, and printing the sequence needs predecessor links on the side.

say.zh: 最长递增子序列我用 O(n log n) 的做法：维护 tails，tails[k] 是长度为 k+1 的递增子序列可能的最小结尾。它本身递增，所以每来一个数就二分找第一个大于等于它的位置替换，找不到就追加。结尾越小越容易被后面接上，所以替换不会让答案变差，最后 tails 的长度就是答案。要求非严格递增时把 lower_bound 换成 upper_bound。
say.en: For the longest increasing subsequence I use the O(n log n) method with an array tails, where tails[k] is the smallest possible end of an increasing subsequence of length k + 1. tails is itself sorted, so for each number I binary search the first entry at least as large and replace it, or append when there is none. A smaller end is easier to extend, so replacing never hurts, and the final length of tails is the answer. For non-decreasing subsequences I use upper bound instead of lower bound.

why.zh: 状态定义在前缀上：dp[i][j] 只关心 a 的前 i 个字符和 b 的前 j 个字符。任何编辑序列都能按「最后一个字符怎么处理」归入匹配、替换、删除、插入之一，所以转移覆盖了全部情况。
why.en: States are on prefixes: dp[i][j] concerns only the first i characters of a and the first j of b, and every edit sequence falls into one of match, replace, delete or insert by what happens to the last characters, so the transition covers every case.

why.zh: 末尾字符相同时直接继承 dp[i−1][j−1] 是安全的：总存在一个最优方案让这两个字符对齐，对齐它们不会更差。
why.en: Inheriting dp[i−1][j−1] when the last characters match is safe: some optimal alignment pairs those two characters, so pairing them costs nothing extra.

why.zh: 多出的一行一列代表空串，dp[i][0] = i、dp[0][j] = j 分别是全删和全插，边界因此统一。
why.en: The extra row and column stand for the empty string, with dp[i][0] = i and dp[0][j] = j meaning delete everything or insert everything, which makes the boundaries uniform.

say.zh: 两个字符串的 DP，我定义 dp[i][j] 为 a 的前 i 个字符和 b 的前 j 个字符上的答案，多开一行一列代表空串。以编辑距离为例：末尾字符相同就继承左上角，不同就在替换、删除、插入对应的左上、上、左三个格子里取最小再加一。任何编辑序列都能按最后一个字符怎么处理归到这几类，所以不会漏。最长公共子序列、通配符匹配也是这张表，只是转移不同，复杂度 O(m × n)。
say.en: For two-string DP I let dp[i][j] be the answer for the first i characters of a and the first j of b, with an extra row and column for the empty string. For edit distance, matching last characters inherit the diagonal, and otherwise I take one plus the minimum of the diagonal, upper and left cells for replace, delete and insert. Any sequence of edits falls into one of those cases by what it does with the last characters, so nothing is missed. Longest common subsequence and wildcard matching use the same table with other transitions, in O(m × n).

why.zh: dp[i][j]（s[i..j] 的最长回文子序列）只依赖 dp[i+1][j−1]、dp[i+1][j]、dp[i][j−1]，都是更短的区间，所以 i 从后往前、j 从前往后填，用到时一定已经算好。
why.en: dp[i][j], the longest palindromic subsequence of s[i..j], depends only on dp[i+1][j−1], dp[i+1][j] and dp[i][j−1], all shorter ranges, so filling i backwards and j forwards guarantees they are ready.

why.zh: 两端相等时把两端都用上不会更差：任何最优回文如果没有同时用上这两个字符，可以把它最外层的一对换成这两个字符，长度不变。
why.en: When the ends match, using both is never worse: an optimal palindrome that does not use both can swap its outermost pair for them without getting shorter.

why.zh: 中心扩展：每个回文子串都有唯一的中心（一个字符或两个字符之间），一共 2n − 1 个中心，从每个中心向外扩展就枚举了所有回文子串。
why.en: Expanding around centres: every palindromic substring has a unique centre, a character or the gap between two, so expanding from all 2n − 1 centres enumerates every palindromic substring.

say.zh: 回文区间 DP，我定义 dp[i][j] 为 s[i..j] 上的答案。两端相等就向内收缩并加 2，否则去掉一端，在两种里取更好的。每个状态只依赖更短的区间，所以 i 从后往前、j 从前往后填表。如果是连续的回文子串，我更常用中心扩展：2n − 1 个中心各自向外扩，O(n²) 时间、O(1) 空间。
say.en: For palindrome ranges I let dp[i][j] be the answer on s[i..j]. If the two ends match, I move inward and add two; otherwise I drop one end and keep the better result. Every state depends only on shorter ranges, so I fill i backwards and j forwards. For contiguous palindromic substrings I usually expand around each of the 2n − 1 centres instead, which is O(n²) time and O(1) space.

why.zh: 以 i 结尾的连续子数组只有两种：只含 nums[i]，或者是以 i−1 结尾的某个子数组再接上 nums[i]，所以「重新开始」和「延续」覆盖了全部情况。
why.en: A contiguous subarray ending at i is either nums[i] alone or a subarray ending at i − 1 extended by nums[i], so restart and extend cover every case.

why.zh: 乘以负数会让最大变最小、最小变最大，所以以 i 结尾的最大乘积只可能是 x、hi·x、lo·x 之一，同时维护 hi 和 lo 才完整。
why.en: Multiplying by a negative number swaps the largest and the smallest, so the best product ending at i must be one of x, hi·x and lo·x; tracking both hi and lo makes the case analysis complete.

why.zh: 答案是所有位置 hi 的最大值，而不是最后一个 hi，因为最优子数组可以在任意位置结束。
why.en: The answer is the maximum of hi over all positions, not the last hi, because the best subarray can end anywhere.

say.zh: 连续子数组的题，我把状态定义成以 i 结尾，这样只有两种转移：接在前一个后面，或者从 i 重新开始。最大乘积子数组里，负数会让最大值和最小值互换，所以我同时维护以 i 结尾的最大乘积和最小乘积，新值从 x、hi 乘 x、lo 乘 x 三个候选里取。答案是每个位置 hi 的最大值。一遍扫描，O(n) 时间、O(1) 空间。
say.en: For contiguous subarray problems I define the state as ending at i, which leaves two transitions: extend the previous run or restart at i. In maximum product subarray a negative number swaps the largest and smallest products, so I keep both the max and the min ending at i, and each new value comes from x, hi times x or lo times x. The answer is the largest hi seen at any position. It is one pass, O(n) time and O(1) space.

why.zh: 每天结束时只可能处于有限几种状态（持股、刚卖出在冷冻期、空仓可买）。列出每种状态由昨天哪种状态、经过今天什么动作到达，就覆盖了所有交易序列。
why.en: At the end of each day you are in one of a few states (holding, just sold and cooling down, free to buy); listing which state yesterday plus which action today reaches each one covers every possible trade sequence.

why.zh: 冷冻期的约束体现在「买入只能从空仓状态转移」：卖出当天进入冷冻态，第二天只能转成空仓，不能直接买。
why.en: The cooldown is enforced by allowing buys only from the free state: selling moves you into cooldown, and the next day you can only become free, not buy.

why.zh: 今天的三个值都必须由昨天的值算出，要同时赋值或用临时变量；否则同一天先卖后买会被错误地算进去。
why.en: All three of today's values must come from yesterday's, assigned together or through temporaries; otherwise a sale and a purchase on the same day sneak in.

say.zh: 股票题我画状态机：每天结束时可能持股、刚卖出处于冷冻期，或者空仓可以买。然后写出每个状态由昨天哪个状态、今天做了什么转移过来，比如持股等于昨天就持股和昨天空仓今天买入两者取大。今天的值都要从昨天的值算，所以同时赋值。最多 k 笔交易就加一维 k，手续费在卖出时扣一次，O(n) 时间、O(1) 空间。
say.en: For stock problems I draw a state machine: at the end of a day I am holding, cooling down after a sale, or free to buy. Then I write each state from yesterday's states and today's action, for example holding is the better of holding already and buying today from free. All of today's values must come from yesterday's, so I assign them together. At most k trades adds a dimension for k, a fee is subtracted once per sale, and it all runs in O(n) time with O(1) space.

why.zh: 按结束时间排序后，第 i 个工作要么不选（dp[i−1]），要么选；选了它，前面只能接结束不晚于它开始的工作，这些工作恰好构成一个前缀，所以转移是 dp[p] + profit。
why.en: After sorting by end time, job i is either skipped (dp[i−1]) or taken; if taken, the jobs before it must end by its start, and those form a prefix of the sorted list, so the transition is dp[p] + profit.

why.zh: 「与 i 兼容的工作是一个前缀」依赖按结束时间排序：结束时间单调，所以可以二分找到最后一个结束时间 ≤ start[i] 的位置 p。
why.en: That the compatible jobs form a prefix relies on sorting by end time: end times are monotone, so binary search finds the last one ending at or before start[i].

why.zh: 和不带权的区间贪心不同：带权后结束早的工作不一定更好，交换论证失效，所以需要 DP 比较选与不选。
why.en: Unlike the unweighted greedy, an early-ending job is no longer always better once jobs have weights; the exchange argument fails, so DP has to compare taking and skipping.

say.zh: 带权区间调度，我先按结束时间排序，dp[i] 表示前 i 个工作能拿到的最大收益。第 i 个工作要么不选，答案是 dp[i−1]；要么选，就接在最后一个与它不重叠的工作后面。因为结束时间有序，与它兼容的工作正好是一个前缀，可以二分找到边界，所以整体 O(n log n)。带权之后贪心的交换论证不成立，这就是要用 DP 的原因。
say.en: For weighted interval scheduling I sort by end time and let dp[i] be the best profit using the first i jobs. Job i is either skipped, giving dp[i − 1], or taken after the last job that does not overlap it. Because end times are sorted, the compatible jobs form a prefix, and binary search finds where it ends, so the whole thing is O(n log n). Once jobs carry weights the greedy exchange argument fails, which is why this needs DP.

why.zh: 按「当前节点选或不选」拆状态后，子树之间互不影响：选了当前节点，孩子必须不选；不选当前节点，每个孩子在两种状态里自由取较大者。两种情况覆盖全部方案。
why.en: Splitting the state by whether the node is taken makes subtrees independent: if it is taken, its children must be skipped; if not, each child freely takes its better state. The two cases cover every plan.

why.zh: 后序遍历保证算当前节点时两个孩子的结果都已就绪，每个节点只算一次，O(n)。
why.en: Post-order ensures both children's results are ready before the node is computed, and each node is computed once, O(n).

why.zh: 博弈用分差：dp[i][j] 表示当前玩家在 nums[i..j] 上最多能领先对手多少分。拿走一端后，对手面对的子区间是同样的问题，所以 dp[i][j] = max(nums[i] − dp[i+1][j], nums[j] − dp[i][j−1])。
why.en: Games use the score difference: dp[i][j] is how far the player to move can finish ahead on nums[i..j]. After taking one end, the opponent faces the same problem on the rest, so dp[i][j] = max(nums[i] − dp[i+1][j], nums[j] − dp[i][j−1]).

say.zh: 树形 DP 我用后序遍历，每个节点返回一个二元组：选它时的最优值和不选它时的最优值。选了它，两个孩子都只能不选；不选它，每个孩子在两种里取更大的。这样子树互不干扰，每个节点算一次，O(n)。双人博弈我用当前玩家能领先多少分做状态，拿走一端后对手面对的是同样的子问题，减去它的结果即可。
say.en: For tree DP I go post-order and each node returns a pair: the best value if it is taken and if it is skipped. If it is taken both children must be skipped; if not, each child contributes the larger of its two values. Subtrees stay independent and each node is computed once, so it is O(n). For two-player games I use how far the player to move can finish ahead, because after taking one end the opponent faces the same subproblem and I subtract its result.

why.zh: 不变式：hasNext 返回后，(r, c) 要么指向下一个有效元素，要么 r 已经越过最后一行；next 只读取并前进一格，下一次 hasNext 再恢复不变式。
why.en: Invariant: after hasNext returns, (r, c) points at the next valid element or r has passed the last row; next only reads and steps once, and the following hasNext restores the invariant.

why.zh: 幂等：hasNext 只跳过已读完或为空的行，已经指向有效元素时什么都不改，所以连续调用多次结果一样。
why.en: Idempotence: hasNext only skips finished or empty rows and changes nothing when already on a valid element, so repeated calls give the same answer.

why.zh: 均摊 O(1)：每一行最多被跳过一次，每个元素只被读一次，总工作量是行数加元素数。
why.en: Amortised O(1): every row is skipped at most once and every element is read once, so total work is rows plus elements.

say.zh: 迭代器设计我把跳过空行、走到下一个有效元素放在 hasNext 里，next 只负责读取当前元素并前进一格，开头先调用一次 hasNext 防止越界。这样 hasNext 连续调用多次也没有副作用。我只保存行号和列号，不在构造函数里把所有元素拷贝成一个大数组。每行最多被跳过一次，所以每次调用均摊 O(1)。
say.en: For iterator design I put skipping empty rows and reaching the next valid element in hasNext, while next only reads the current element and steps forward, calling hasNext first to stay in bounds. That way calling hasNext repeatedly has no side effects. I keep only a row and column index instead of copying everything into one big array in the constructor. Each row is skipped at most once, so every call is amortised O(1).

why.zh: 链表顺序就是最近使用顺序：每次 get 或 put 都把节点移到头部，所以尾部永远是最久未使用的，淘汰它正好符合 LRU 的定义。
why.en: The list order is the recency order: every get or put moves the node to the front, so the tail is always the least recently used entry, and evicting it is exactly LRU.

why.zh: 哈希表和链表始终同步：每个键在表里恰好对应链表中的一个节点，插入、移动、删除都同时改两边，所以 get 不会读到已淘汰的节点。
why.en: The map and the list stay in sync: each key maps to exactly one node in the list, and every insert, move and delete updates both, so get never finds an evicted node.

why.zh: 双向链表加哨兵，摘下一个节点只要改它前后两个指针，O(1)，不需要从头找前驱。
why.en: A doubly linked list with sentinels unlinks a node by rewiring its two neighbours in O(1), with no search for the predecessor.

say.zh: LRU 缓存我用哈希表加双向链表。哈希表从键 O(1) 找到节点，链表按最近使用排序，头部最新、尾部最旧。get 命中就把节点移到头部；put 已有的键就更新并移到头部，否则插到头部，超出容量就删掉尾部节点，并从哈希表里一起删掉。手写链表时加头尾哨兵，所有操作都不用判空，get 和 put 都是 O(1)。
say.en: For an LRU cache I combine a hash map with a doubly linked list. The map finds a key's node in O(1), and the list is ordered by recency, newest at the head and oldest at the tail. A hit on get moves the node to the head; put on an existing key updates it and moves it, otherwise it inserts at the head and, past capacity, removes the tail node from both the list and the map. With sentinel head and tail nodes there are no null checks, and get and put are both O(1).

why.zh: 字典树的每个节点唯一对应一个前缀（从根到它的路径），所以查前缀就是沿路径走 L 步，和存了多少个单词无关。
why.en: Every trie node corresponds to exactly one prefix, the path from the root to it, so looking up a prefix walks L steps regardless of how many words are stored.

why.zh: 节点上的计数（经过的单词数、在此结束的单词数）在插入时沿路径各加一，所以以某个前缀开头的单词数就是终点节点上的计数。
why.en: Counts on nodes (words passing through, words ending here) are incremented along the path on insert, so the number of words with a given prefix is simply the count on its last node.

why.zh: 带空标记的先序序列能唯一确定一棵二叉树：反序列化按同样的顺序读，遇到空标记就返回，每个值和每个空位都恰好被读一次。
why.en: A preorder sequence with null markers determines a binary tree uniquely: deserializing reads it back in the same order, returning at each null marker, so every value and every empty slot is consumed exactly once.

say.zh: 字典树的每个节点代表一个前缀，插入和查找都是一个字符一个字符往下走，复杂度只和单词长度有关。节点上可以存经过的单词数和在此结束的单词数，这样前缀计数和删除都是 O(L)。二叉树序列化我用先序遍历，空节点写成一个特殊标记，比如井号，因为带空标记的先序能唯一确定一棵树。反序列化按同样的顺序读回来，遇到标记就返回空。
say.en: In a trie each node stands for one prefix, and insert and lookup walk down one character at a time, so the cost depends only on the word length. Nodes can store how many words pass through and how many end there, which makes prefix counts and deletion O(L). To serialize a binary tree I write a preorder walk with a marker such as a hash sign for empty children, because preorder with null markers pins down the tree uniquely. Deserializing reads the tokens back in the same order and returns an empty child at each marker.

why.zh: x & (x − 1) 去掉最低位的 1：x − 1 把最低位的 1 变成 0、它右边的 0 全变成 1，再和 x 相与，这一段全变成 0，更高位不变。
why.en: x & (x − 1) clears the lowest set bit: subtracting 1 turns that bit to 0 and the zeros to its right into ones, so the AND zeroes that stretch and leaves the higher bits alone.

why.zh: 快速幂：把指数写成二进制 e = Σ bᵢ·2ⁱ，则 a^e 等于所有 bᵢ = 1 的 a^(2ⁱ) 之积；每轮把底数平方就得到下一个 a^(2ⁱ)，共 O(log e) 轮。
why.en: Fast power: write the exponent in binary, e = Σ bᵢ·2ⁱ, so a^e is the product of a^(2ⁱ) over the bits that are 1; squaring the base each round yields the next a^(2ⁱ), for O(log e) rounds.

why.zh: 异或找唯一数：异或满足交换律和结合律，且 a ^ a = 0、a ^ 0 = a，所以成对出现的数全部抵消，剩下的就是只出现一次的那个。
why.en: XOR finds the single number: XOR is commutative and associative with a ^ a = 0 and a ^ 0 = a, so every pair cancels and only the element that appears once remains.

say.zh: 位运算我常用三个技巧。x & (x − 1) 去掉最低位的 1，可以数 1 的个数或判断 2 的幂；异或满足 a ^ a = 0，成对的数会抵消，用来找只出现一次的数。快速幂把指数拆成二进制，每轮底数平方，遇到 1 的位就乘进结果，O(log n) 次乘法。取模时先转成 64 位再相乘，避免溢出。
say.en: I lean on three bit tricks. x AND (x − 1) clears the lowest set bit, which counts set bits or tests for a power of two, and XOR cancels pairs because a XOR a is zero, which finds the element that appears once. Fast power splits the exponent into bits, squaring the base each round and multiplying it in when the bit is one, for O(log n) multiplications. Under a modulus I widen to 64 bits before multiplying.
